quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Mora x10000, Recipe: Poissonchant Pie x1

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Ah, you finally looked over! Hello there, tall stranger and...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon's Paimon, and {M#he}{F#she}'s {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: #Alright, I got it! {M#Mister}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME} and Miss Paimon. Welcome to Merusea Village!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Miss...?

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: #{M#Ah... Sorry. So sorry. I'm just used to being considerate to the people in the village. Miss Paimon also looked like she could use some care, so I just called her that without thinking...}{F#Ah... Sorry. So sorry. I'm used to showing consideration to people in the village, so I just called you both "Miss" without thinking...}

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #{M#Paimon probably could use some more care indeed...}{F#No need to apologize.}

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{M#Hey! Paimon cares for you all the time too, you know!}{F#Yeah! You don't need to be so nervous! You can call us whatever you want!}

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still... what's your name...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: I'm Serene. Just call me Serene.

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: I heard you were trying to collect components... Did something happen?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You explain everything that happened before to Serene...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: I didn't think something like that would occur... This must be reported to Monsieur Neuvillette immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: #Thank you, {M#Mister}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME} and Miss Paimon. If it weren't for you, something worse would've definitely followed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Seymour still broke down...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Hmm... So that's why you were collecting components, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! Though we're not really sure how to fix him right now... We were thinking that after getting the components, we could go somewhere like the Fontaine Research Institute and find someone to help us...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: If that's the case, then please take this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Are these... components? Are you just giving them to us?

choices.text: Thank you.

response.speaker: Serene
response.text: I should be the one thanking you. Thank you for taking care of Mamere.

response.speaker: Serene
response.text: That child's always alone and never tells me about anything...

response.speaker: Serene
response.text: So, seeing her joyously talking with someone — and that someone being an outsider human friend as well — makes me happy.

response.speaker: Serene
response.text: Though, if I had more components, maybe that could solve the problem immediately, right? It's as I expected. It will take more hard work on my part to better assist everyone...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, you've already helped us. Anyway, we'll be taking these components! Thanks a lot, Serene!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Right, where can we find more components?

response.speaker: Serene
response.text: Hmm... Let me think. You can check the areas around the village. If you're lucky, you might be able to pick up some scattered components.

response.speaker: Serene
response.text: But, this method alone isn't that efficient...

response.speaker: Serene
response.text: So, why don't you ask the villagers if they need help with anything? I'm sure they'll give you components in exchange for that help.

choices.text: Do you need us to help you with anything?

response.speaker: Serene
response.text: Huh? Ah, no! I didn't mean to use this to get your help or anything!

response.speaker: Serene
response.text: #Well, either {NICKNAME} or Mamere are going to need those components, right? So just accept them!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Serene? Why did you call out to us? Did something happen?

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Yeah, so, remember when you two said you wanted to go collect some components, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Collecting components... Ah, you mean fixing Seymour!

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Yeah, at that time I didn't have that many components with me, so I couldn't help you two...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: So I went out and collected some more!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! You sure got a lot!

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Please take them. This way, you can speed up the repairs, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, thanks a lot, but Seymour is already fixed...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Huh? Already? Wow, I should have expected that from you two!

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: If that's the case, you doubly deserve these components!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: You've been putting in a lot of work to help everyone, right?

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: If that's the case, then I would like you two to have these components as a token of my gratitude. Thank you for taking care of everyone in the village!

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: It just so happens that <color=#00E1FFFF>Xana</color> is here in the village too! If you need anything, you can trade with her using these components!

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: #Ah, {M#Mister}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: So... Hmm, about those new pages...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, c'mon, enough about the pages! Aren't you trying to make "That Dish" and prepare the relevant ingredients for it?

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Hmm... Well, since you've overheard, I suppose there really is nothing for it... You two must be included in this as well.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: #A question, if I may! {M#Mister}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME}, what ingredient symbolizes "birth" to you?

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Something that "bestows life" and represents "newborn." I believe you know what I'm looking for, yes?

response.speaker: Canotila
response.text: ...I want a bird egg. Just a bird egg.

response.speaker: Canotila
response.text: But I suppose you can see the rub too, can't you? We Melusines have short arms and can't climb trees well, so it'll be... very troublesome for one of us to get any bird eggs.

choices.text: Don't worry, leave it to me.

response.speaker: Canotila
response.text: Anyway, I leave this to you, alright?

choices.text: You're not going to need a fresh one, are you...

response.speaker: Canotila
response.text: Huh? A fresh bird egg?

response.speaker: Canotila
response.text: #Hmm. That does sound much better than an "ordinary bird egg"! In that case, {M#Mister}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME}, I'll need you to get fresh bird eggs!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no, wait! They're not really any different! An ordinary bird egg will work just fine!

choices.text: You mean... like a bird egg?

response.speaker: Canotila
response.text: Hehe, yeah! That's right! Sharp as always, I see!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: *sigh* But... what should we give Serene?

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: So long as it expresses our intentions, we can give her anything, can we not?

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Yeah, Carabosse said the same thing!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Hmmm... "intentions"... Let me think. Mister Chesil's sent me a new clock, but would a clock really make the best birthday gift?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: After all, Serene's taking care of us all. This would be a great opportunity for me to give her a gift that'll make her happy...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Everyone wants that! Though if we think about it, gifting her something else might end with her turning it away right? She'll say "I can't accept something so valuable" or something like that.

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Yeah...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: If that's the case, then why don't we make her a nice meal? The act of eating together will express our intentions perfectly!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah! You're the best, Canotila! In that case, let's make "That Dish" together!

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Huh? You want to make "That Dish"? Well, preparing it will be a bit...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you need help?

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Huh? Well, that...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: #Ah, it's... it's {M#Mister}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: #Ahaha... Today's weather isn't bad either, {M#Mister}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME}! Did you find any new pages?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Ah, if you're talking about the "Book of Revealing"...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, hold on, no! Don't change the subject! You were just talking about preparing something for Serene...

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Ah! Ah! I just remembered there are notes that need to be collated! I need to get back right now!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: #I—I have also remembered that I need to meet with Mister Chesil tomorrow! I have to go now too! See you, {M#Mister}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Hmm... Golden butterflies...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait! Huh? Why did they all run off?

choices.text: Maybe they don't want anyone else to know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm. So, they're planning to host a big birthday dinner for Serene?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come to think of it, we haven't actually gotten to try the Melusines' dishes! If it's a birthday celebration, the food should be extra fancy, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ooohh, Paimon's starting to look forward to this birthday thing... {NICKNAME}, why don't we find and help them?

choices.text: That's a birthday gift for someone else...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon... Paimon knows that! But... if we prepare a dish with the Melusines, you'll figure out how to make it, won't you? You know, in case Paimon wants some later...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, wait! Paimon means "we"! We can eat it together in the future!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're really something else, Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe. Anyway, let's go check up on them and see if they need our help to prepare anything!

choices.text: Don't you try to sneak a bite, Paimon.
That's what we call a birthday surprise...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Flatbread's a-baking, Flatbread's a-baking~♪

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Puca! About what you said earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: ...Ah! That... that was supposed to be a secret. You can't tell anyone else! Not even Sluasi!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry about a thing! We definitely won't tell anyone else! We just want to help you prepare! Two extra helpers will help get things ready faster, right?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Hmm? Yeah... yeah! I'm sure you two would be a big help!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, right? So, what do you need us to do?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Hmm... The other ingredients are pretty easy to prepare, but we still need that white and sweet thing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You mean sugar?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: No! Not that! Sugar is dangerous! *sigh* Eating that just once will make you always want to eat it. In the end... you'll get all round and stuff...

choices.text: Just like a Breacher Primus?

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Anyway, absolutely no sugar! I almost fell into its sweet trap in the past... We can't let the same thing happen to Serene!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But what else is white and sweet besides sugar?

choices.text: Flour, perhaps?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? How's flour supposed to be sweet?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, wait, you can taste a little sweetness if you sample it for long enough...

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Um, well, I am referring to flour. First, we'll need to make it round. Then we bake it till it's tasty and crispy...

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: But... I've used up all my flour... and Xana doesn't have any, either. We'll need to go out and get more...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #No problem, leave it to us! {NICKNAME}, let's check if we're carrying any flour!

choices.text: (Stares at Paimon.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wh—Why are you staring at Paimon like that?

choices.text: Just like Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Paimon isn't round!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: #Ah! Thanks, {M#Mister}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME}! Thanks, Paimon! This way, we can make some delicious flatbread!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! Paimon can't wait!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, there you are, Verenata!

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: #Uh... Um, hey there, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. What do you need from me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, this has to do with what you were all chatting about earlier. About preparing food for Serene—

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: N—No, wait, please stop talking!

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: We... want to make this a surprise for Serene, and don't want anyone else to know. Not even Carabosse...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry. We won't tell a soul! We just want to help you prepare. This will make things easier for you too, right?

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Hmm... You two are pretty reliable. If that's the case, I've a favor to ask...

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: The dish we're trying to make usually uses... fish.

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: But Lutine told me that... the outside world has something called "bacon," and that it tastes delicious. Monsieur Neuvillette has also enjoyed it before.

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: So, I think that if we can get some "bacon," we might be able to cook something incredible... Just like Carabosse always says, "knowledge is power"!

choices.text: I'm not sure this has anything to do with knowledge...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's the knowledge of what to do with cooking ingredients... kinda-sorta?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, don't worry about it. We've got this bacon thing down pat!

choices.text: "Fontaine is bacon"...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: White and sweet...

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: #Whoa, so this is "bacon"? Thanks a lot, {NICKNAME}, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Still, it's a bit different from what I'd imagined...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't you worry! Bacon tastes good no matter how you prepare it!

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Really? I don't quite get that, but I'll do my best!

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: This "bacon" that Lutine mentioned... I wonder what it is?

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: #Thanks, {M#Mister}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME}! I'm sure that Serene will be happy too!

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Thanks. I'll go prepare the ingredient now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! You got this!

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Well, have you a bird egg with you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! This way, all the ingredients for the dish should be ready!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: #Hehe, you really are awesome, {M#Mister}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Alright! We'll leave the cooking to you, Verenata!

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: A—Alright! You can count on me! I've learned the greatest, bestest, most powerful-est cooking methods from Carabosse and Lutine!

choices.text: You got this!

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Carabosse once said that the most important thing in cooking is vigor, and the will to never give up! We must never surrender to the ingredients, no matter what!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This style of cooking is already entirely different from what Paimon's familiar with...

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: No worries, no worries! Nothing will go wrong! Probably!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Under your supervision, Verenata gathers two pieces of flatbread, seven fish, the cooked bird egg, and sliced bacon before throwing them all into the pot at once and stirring away with focus and gusto...\nThis really doesn't seem like the way flatbread is cooked, but it's too late to stop the process at this point...

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Mm-hmm! There we go! All done, easy-peasy!

response.speaker: Canotila
response.text: Oh, it looks pretty good! I think Serene will definitely be pleased!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: #Of course! Why, I'm already super happy! Anyway, we should also thank {M#Mister}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME} for helping us make such a wonderful meal!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Paimon's gonna ask, just in case...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... what is this?

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Huh? Haven't you seen Poissonchant Pie before, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, that sounds and looks like you'd use it to cast some kind of forbidden magic or something!

response.speaker: Canotila
response.text: Huh? Why?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, you're the one who called it "Poissonchant"... Also, look at all these fish heads!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Hehe! They're so cute, right? They look just like a choir in a picture book, with everyone holding their heads up high and singing happily—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Which part of that dish even remotely looks like what you're talking about?

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Hmm... Since neither of you have seen a Poissonchant Pie before, then maybe we should give you two a serving first!

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: You both were a big help after all — I mean, you look after us just like Miss Serene does.

response.speaker: Canotila
response.text: Hmm, I'd say that Serene's a bit noisier and nosier at times, actively trying to help when we don't need it...

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: That's just the way she is...

response.speaker: Canotila
response.text: #But either way, {M#Mister}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME} and Paimon are better at... caring for people?

response.speaker: Canotila
response.text: Anyway, we would like the two of you to accept our "goodwill"!

choices.text: Hehe, awesome! This looks delicious!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Huh? {NICKNAME}, you can't be serious... right?

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: #Hehe, you look so happy right now, {M#Mister}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Canotila
response.text: Alright, let's go give the Poissonchant Pie to Serene!

choices.text: Okay. Let's go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Will this... really be okay?

choices.text: Am I coming along as well?

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Yup. I mean, you helped prepare the ingredients after all! And besides, the more people who eat together, the merrier, right?

choices.text: Hmm. Uh, thanks?
As long as it doesn't turn out like your potions...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh! Don't make Paimon remember that smell!

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: I got it this time! Don't worry about it!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You look for Serene together with everyone else...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Well, I suppose this should be fine now...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: #Ah. Hello, {NICKNAME}, Paimon! Is there something you need?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? What are you doing, Serene?

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Oh, are you talking about this thing? Well, Xana accidentally broke the water bottle she usually carries with her, so I came by to try and fix it...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: #So, {NICKNAME} and Paimon... Do you need me to help with something?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, do you remember what day it is?

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Huh? Come to think of it, today's the day that I'll need to submit a report to Monsieur Neuvillette...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's not what we're talking about!

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Seriously, you should consider yourself more. It's your birthday, you know...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Come, everyone! Altogether now!

dialogues.speaker: Canotila, Puca, and Verenata
dialogues.text: Happy birthday!

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Eh?

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} helped us prepare a totally unique Poissonchant Pie for your birthday!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: This is for all the time you've spent taking care of us, and for all your help when I was trying to communicate with Mister Chesil...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Well, you're really noisy sometimes, but as long as you don't suddenly pop in and interrupt my thoughts, you're welcome to be even louder if you want.

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: I... everyone...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Come on, that's no way to look at your own birthday. Anyway, if we don't eat the Poissonchant Pie we spent so long preparing soon, it'll get cold.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: #Come, let's eat! You too, {M#Mister}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

choices.text: My taste buds were born for such adventure!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, how does this count as an adventure?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You enjoy the strange Poissonchant Pie with the Melusines...\nThough it looks rather strange, the taste isn't as bad as you expected. On the contrary, it's quite delicious, so long as you can stomach the stares of the fish heads, their eyes still gleaming with a strange light...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? It... tastes pretty good...

choices.text: Another!

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Ah, but we don't have any more... If you're still hungry, though, we can make more together in the future!

response.speaker: Canotila
response.text: Come on, make a wish — and make sure it's a wish for yourself!

response.speaker: Serene
response.text: Well, if that's the case, my wish has already come true.

response.speaker: Serene
response.text: #Thank you everyone! Thank you, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

choices.text: Humanity might not yet be ready for this wonder...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, though it tastes good, it looks...

choices.text: Do I... really have to eat this...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Uh... Well, here goes nothing. Paimon should have a nibble at least...)

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Hmm, if we wrap the fish inside the bacon...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's open the shell first...
